mapper.sql: SELECT f.flow_id, f.textbook_id, f.isbn, i.book_name, f.business_type, f.change_qty, f.stock_before, f.stock_after, f.operator, f.business_no, f.remark, f.operate_time, f.create_time FROM textbook_stock_flow f LEFT JOIN textbook_info i ON f.textbook_id = i.book_id
mapper.select: WHERE 1=1 AND f.textbook_id = #{bookId} AND f.isbn like concat('%', #{isbn}, '%') AND f.business_type = #{bizType} AND f.remark like concat('%', #{refBizType}, '%') AND date_format(f.operate_time,'%y%m%d') >= date_format(#{params.beginTime},'%y%m%d') AND date_format(f.operate_time,'%y%m%d') <= date_format(#{params.endTime},'%y%m%d') ORDER BY f.operate_time DESC
WHERE f.textbook_id = #{bookId} ORDER BY f.operate_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO textbook_stock_flow(textbook_id, isbn, business_type, business_no, change_qty, stock_before, stock_after, operator, operate_time, remark) VALUES(#{bookId}, #{isbn}, #{bizType}, #{refBizId}, #{changeNum}, #{beforeStock}, #{afterStock}, #{operatorName}, NOW(), #{remark})

INSERT INTO textbook_stock_flow(textbook_id, isbn, business_type, business_no, change_qty, stock_before, stock_after, operator, operate_time, remark, create_time) VALUES
(#{item.bookId}, #{item.isbn}, #{item.bizType}, #{item.refBizId}, #{item.changeNum}, #{item.beforeStock}, #{item.afterStock}, #{item.operatorName}, NOW(), #{item.remark}, NOW())
